approach.title: Therapy that makes space for you.
approach.body: Our work is collaborative and shaped around your experiences, goals, and pace. Zoe draws on integrative, person-centred, CBT-informed, and trauma-informed approaches to help you understand what is happening and find a way forward.
principles: Space to move at a pace that feels manageable

qualifications.title: A thoughtful, responsible space
qualifications.body: Zoe is committed to ethical practice, ongoing learning, and creating a confidential environment where clients feel respected and heard.
